abilities.name: Edge of Life and Death
mechanics: While in Yin Vessel, Basic Attack - Drink Soul performs up to 4 consecutive Fusion-damage attacks.
Drink Soul Stage 3 and Stage 4 each restore 50 Qi and deal Heavy Attack DMG.
While in Yang Font, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane performs up to 4 consecutive Fusion-damage attacks.
Devil's Bane Stage 3 and Stage 4 each restore 50 Qi and deal Heavy Attack DMG.
Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina to perform a plunging Fusion-damage attack.
After Mid-air Attack, pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Drink Soul Stage 2 in Yin Vessel or Devil's Bane Stage 2 in Yang Font.
After a successful Dodge in Yin Vessel, Dodge Counter - Nether Dive deals Fusion DMG, restores 100 Qi, deals Heavy Attack DMG, and can be followed shortly by Drink Soul Stage 4.
After a successful Dodge in Yang Font, Dodge Counter - Light Watch deals Fusion DMG, restores 100 Qi, deals Heavy Attack DMG, and can be followed shortly by Devil's Bane Stage 4.

Shadow Step is cast on the ground by pressing Dodge with directional input while in combat. It deals a fixed amount of Fusion DMG counted as Basic Attack DMG; this damage is unaffected by DMG Bonus effects.
A successful Dodge may be triggered during Shadow Step.
After Shadow Step, pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Drink Soul Stage 2 in Yin Vessel or Devil's Bane Stage 2 in Yang Font.

abilities.name: Malevolent Encounter
mechanics: In Yin Vessel, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin deals Fusion DMG and can be cast in mid-air.
In Yang Font, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang deals Fusion DMG and can be cast in mid-air.

Casting Encroaching Yin or Scorching Yang grants Cleanse of Impurity for 4 seconds or until switching Resonators, switching between Yin Vessel and Yang Font, or casting Netherworld Traverse or Afterlife's Guide.

While in Yin Vessel with Cleanse of Impurity, pressing or holding Normal Attack in mid-air casts Netherworld Traverse. It deals Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG, restores 100 Qi, and can be followed shortly by Drink Soul Stage 2.

While in Yang Font with Cleanse of Impurity, pressing or holding Normal Attack in mid-air casts Afterlife's Guide. It deals Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG, restores 100 Qi, and can be followed shortly by Devil's Bane Stage 2.

abilities.name: Upstream Along Santu
mechanics: Qi Modulation lets Jingran change states through Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran starts in Yang Font by default.

In Yin Vessel, when holding 300 Qi, holding Normal Attack consumes 300 Qi to cast Soul Raid, which deals Fusion DMG and switches Jingran to Yang Font. It can be followed shortly by Devil's Bane Stage 2.

In Yang Font, when holding 300 Qi, holding Normal Attack consumes 300 Qi to cast Stardome Meander, which deals Fusion DMG, switches Jingran to Yin Vessel, and can be cast in mid-air. It can be followed shortly by Drink Soul Stage 2.
Qi has a maximum of 300 points.
Drink Soul Stage 3/4 and Devil's Bane Stage 3/4 each restore 50 Qi.
Nether Dive, Light Watch, Netherworld Traverse, Afterlife's Guide, and Intro Skill - Question the Tombs each restore 100 Qi.
Burial of Thousand Souls, Soul Raid, and Stardome Meander restore 200 Qi when cast with Wayfarer's Mark.
Fire of Life has a maximum of 100 points. Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 Fire of Life.
All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.

During Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is above 0, Soul Raid or Stardome Meander consumes 25 Fire of Life and gains an increased DMG multiplier based on Jingran's Max HP. The increase applies for every 1,000 Max HP above 25,000, with at most 25,000 HP counted; the source does not provide the numerical multiplier.
Nether to Light fixes Jingran's DEF at 0.
Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus equal to 6.2% for every 1,000 Max HP, capped at 310%.
Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus equal to 1.5% for every 1,000 Max HP, capped at 75%.
Yang Changes, Yin Unites grants 36 additional ATK for every 1,000 Max HP, capped at 1,800 ATK.

abilities.name: Hark the Dust
mechanics: Casting Intro Skill - Question the Tombs, Encroaching Yin, or Scorching Yang grants Earth Charm.
For 15 seconds, while Jingran is the active Resonator, Earth Charm grants an unstackable shield equal to 1.6% of Max HP + 700 for 5 seconds whenever he deals damage.
The Earth Charm shield trigger can occur once every 0.5 seconds and is not passed to the incoming Resonator.
During Yinghuo, while Jingran is active, dealing damage grants an unstackable shield equal to 0.8% of Max HP + 350 for 5 seconds.
The Yinghuo shield trigger can occur once every 0.5 seconds and is not passed to the incoming Resonator.

abilities.name: Trace the Vestige
mechanics: When entering combat, if Ghost Shroud is below 25, restore it to 25. This can trigger once every 4 seconds.
When a nearby team Resonator other than Jingran gains a shield, Jingran gains 2 Ghost Shroud. This can trigger once every 0.5 seconds.
Upon entering combat, Jingran gains Fixation; this can trigger once every 4 seconds.
Casting Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil grants Fixation.
When a nearby team Resonator other than Jingran gains a shield, Jingran gains 15 Ghost Shroud and removes Fixation.

abilities.name: Burial of Thousand Souls
mechanics: Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Attacks the target with Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG and grants 100 Fire of Life.
After casting, if current HP is above 50% of Max HP, current HP is reduced to 50% of Max HP.
After casting, Jingran gains 200 Qi, 3 stacks of Wayfarer's Mark, and enters Yinghuo for 15 seconds.
Wayfarer's Mark has a maximum of 3 stacks. During its 15-second duration, casting Soul Raid or Stardome Meander restores 200 Qi and consumes 1 Wayfarer's Mark.

During Yinghuo, dealing damage with Soul Raid or Stardome Meander summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets with Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG. This can trigger once per Soul Raid or Stardome Meander.
All Fire of Life is removed when Yinghuo ends.
quantitative_details: Burial of Thousand Souls DMG: 46.86%*8 (skill Lv.1)

abilities.name: Question the Tombs
mechanics: Attacks the target with Fusion DMG.
Consumes all Ghost Shroud and converts it into the same number of Fortune in Disguise stacks.
Restores 100 Qi.
After casting, pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Drink Soul Stage 2 in Yin Vessel or Devil's Bane Stage 2 in Yang Font.
Fortune in Disguise has a maximum of 50 stacks. Each stack grants additional Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: 0.05% for every 1,000 Max HP, capped at 2.5% per stack.
Fortune in Disguise lasts 15 seconds and ends when Jingran switches to another Resonator.
Ghost Shroud has a maximum of 50 points.
Whenever Jingran gains a shield, he gains 1 Ghost Shroud; this can trigger once every 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil
mechanics: Deals Fusion DMG equal to 795% of Jingran's ATK.
Casting this Outro grants Fixation according to Inherent Skill 2.
quantitative_details: Outro DMG: 795% of Jingran's ATK (skill Lv.1)

abilities.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
mechanics: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Jingran may cast Tune Break on the target.
After casting, pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Drink Soul Stage 2 in Yin Vessel or Devil's Bane Stage 2 in Yang Font.

abilities.name: Yinghuo
mechanics: Yinghuo is entered through Burial of Thousand Souls and lasts 15 seconds.
During Yinghuo, Soul Raid and Stardome Meander can consume Fire of Life to increase their DMG multiplier based on Max HP.
Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.

abilities.name: Edge of Life and Death
mechanics: Provides two Crit. Rate attribute nodes.

abilities.name: Malevolent Encounter
mechanics: Provides two HP attribute nodes.

sequences.name: Yin and Yang in Harmony, the Ultimate Law of Being
effects: Increases the DMG multipliers of Encroaching Yin, Netherworld Traverse, Scorching Yang, and Afterlife's Guide by 80%.
These four Resonance Skills become immune to interruption.

sequences.name: A Solitary Lantern, Across Lands Shade-Trodden
effects: Increases the DMG multipliers of Soul Raid and Stardome Meander by 46%.
During Yinghuo, increases the Fire of Life-based DMG multiplier increase for Soul Raid and Stardome Meander by 46%.
Upon entering combat, once every 4 seconds, Jingran gains 300 Qi and Netherworld's Boon.
Netherworld's Boon causes Soul Raid or Stardome Meander to restore 25% of Max Resonance Energy and grants those attacks 180% DMG Amplification for 4 seconds.

sequences.name: World's Course Shifts, Each to Their Rightful Paths
effects: Casting Soul Raid or Stardome Meander grants 5 Ghost Shroud.
For 15 seconds after casting Burial of Thousand Souls, Yang Changes, Yin Unites is replaced by Yin-Yang Everflow.
Yin-Yang Everflow grants additional ATK based on Max HP: 50 ATK per 1,000 Max HP, capped at 2,500 ATK.

sequences.name: Where Reality Meets Illusion, Where Living Meet Dead
effects: When any team Resonator gains a shield, all team Resonators gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30 seconds.

sequences.name: Ends Return to Beginnings, Truth of Life Laid Bare
effects: When Jingran would receive a fatal blow, he does not fall and instead gains a shield equal to 50% of Max HP for 15 seconds.
This can trigger once every 10 minutes.
The shield is not passed to the incoming Resonator.

sequences.name: As Favors and Feuds Fade, New Stories Await
effects: Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran.
Increases Chimei Wangliang's DMG multiplier by 80%.
Upon entering Yinghuo, Jingran gains Parade of Thousand Souls for 15 seconds.
While Parade of Thousand Souls is active and Jingran is the active Resonator, dealing damage summons Chimei Wangliang; this can occur once per second, up to 8 times.
Parade of Thousand Souls ends and its available summon charges reset when Burial of Thousand Souls is cast, or when Yinghuo ends or is removed.

abilities.name: Strings to Steel
mechanics: Basic Attack - Stringblade performs up to 4 consecutive Aero attacks by pressing or holding Normal Attack.
Stringblade Stage 1 and Stage 4 are in Sheathed Stance; Stages 2 and 3 are in Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade becomes available when Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full. Hold Normal Attack to consume Stamina and deal Aero DMG; this consumes all Qin Heart and Sword Cadence and enters Ephemeral Transcendence.
Mid-air Attack - Stringblade performs up to 3 consecutive Aero attacks by pressing or holding Normal Attack in mid-air. It is in Drawn Stance.
After landing from Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
While in mid-air, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
While in Sword Flight, Jump is replaced by Plunging Attack. Plunging Attack consumes Stamina and deals Aero DMG.
Outside Ephemeral Transcendence, pressing Normal Attack within a certain time after Plunging Attack casts Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
Dodge Counter - Stringblade is cast by pressing Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge. It deals Aero DMG and is in Drawn Stance.
Pressing or holding Normal Attack within a certain time after Dodge Counter - Stringblade casts Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.
While in mid-air, Dodge is replaced by Sword Glide.

abilities.name: Severing Note
mechanics: Severing Note: Judgement deals Aero DMG and grants 45 Qin Heart.
Outside Ephemeral Transcendence, pressing or holding Normal Attack within a certain time after Judgement casts Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.
While casting Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Stage 3, or Dodge Counter - Stringblade, Resonance Skill is replaced by Severing Note: Ascendant.
Severing Note: Ascendant deals Aero DMG and is in Drawn Stance.

abilities.name: Formless Heart Sword
mechanics: Ephemeral Transcendence makes Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence available.
Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence performs up to 4 consecutive Aero attacks by pressing or holding Normal Attack and can be cast in mid-air.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence damage is increased by 100%.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence is cast after a successful Dodge, deals Aero DMG, and can be cast in mid-air. Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, its damage is increased by 100%.

When Heart Sword Intent is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence. It deals Aero DMG, consumes all Heart Sword Intent, and ends Ephemeral Transcendence.
Mindlock can stack up to 15 times. Whenever a team Resonator inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on a target, Qingxiao inflicts 1 Mindlock stack on that target.

Each Mindlock stack amplifies the target's damage taken from Qingxiao's Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven, Qingxiao gains Heaven's Clarity.
While Heaven's Clarity is active, damage from Sheathed Stance and Drawn Stance moves doubles the rates at which Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are obtained.

While Heaven's Clarity is active, Heavy Attack - Stringblade inflicts 3 Mindlock stacks on nearby targets and enhances the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its damage multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target.
Switching to another Resonator ends the Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence enhancement.
Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heaven's Clarity.
Casting Intro Skill - Tonality Shift or Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants 1 Swordlight Ward stack; the maximum is 1 stack.
When Qingxiao takes damage from an enemy attack, Swordlight Ward can be consumed to grant interruption immunity and reduce damage taken by 60% for 1 second. This can trigger once per second.
Sword Flight is a special movement state that continuously consumes Flight Qi.

The following skills enter Sword Flight: Sword Dodge, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stages 1 and 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.

Sword Flight ends when Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 or Plunging Attack is cast, certain environmental interactions or Utilities are triggered, Qingxiao returns to the ground, she switches to another Resonator, or Flight Qi is depleted.
While in Sword Flight, holding Jump performs Sword Step, a short forward leap/dash. Sword Step can be used once per Sword Flight.
Qin Heart has a maximum of 100 points. Damage from Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart; it cannot be gained during Ephemeral Transcendence.
Sword Cadence has a maximum of 100 points. Damage from Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence; it cannot be gained during Ephemeral Transcendence.
Heart Sword Intent has a maximum of 100 points. Damage from Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.

abilities.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
mechanics: Upon entering combat, Qingxiao gains 1 Gathered Mind stack.

After direct damage from a team Resonator defeats a target affected by Mindlock, Qingxiao gains Gathered Mind if she has none, with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks. If she already has Gathered Mind and the target has at least as many Mindlock stacks as her current Gathered Mind, her Gathered Mind is updated to that count.
Gathered Mind can stack up to 15 times and lasts 30 seconds.
After team Resonators damage a target, Gathered Mind inflicts Mindlock on that target equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This can trigger only once on the same target.

When a team Resonator casts Tune Break on a target with Tune Strain - Shifting, this skill additionally inflicts 1 Tune Strain - Interfered stack on that target. This can trigger only once on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she cannot gain Gathered Mind and existing Gathered Mind becomes inactive.

abilities.name: To Know, To Banish
mechanics: Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven deal 2% more damage per Mindlock stack on the target, plus an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
Whenever a team Resonator inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, Qingxiao additionally inflicts 1 Mindlock stack on that target.

abilities.name: Billows Beneath Heaven
mechanics: Deals Aero DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

abilities.name: Tonality Shift
mechanics: Deals Aero DMG.
Grants 30 Sword Cadence and Resonant Chime.
Resonant Chime causes the next Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement to grant 30 Qin Heart and remove Resonant Chime.
Casting this Intro Skill also grants 1 Swordlight Ward through Formless Heart Sword and enters Sword Flight.

abilities.name: Lingering Song
mechanics: Deals damage equal to 800% of Qingxiao's ATK.

abilities.name: Draw and Sunder
mechanics: After dealing damage with a skill, Qingxiao inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target; each skill can trigger this only once per target.
Qingxiao can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
For every Tune Strain - Interfered stack on the target, each point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases her total damage to that target by 0.12%.
While Qingxiao is in the team, the target's maximum Tune Strain - Interfered stack limit increases by 1.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Qingxiao can cast Tune Break.
While grounded and outside Ephemeral Transcendence, pressing Normal Attack within a certain time after Tune Break casts Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

abilities.name: Stances, Sword Flight, and Attribute Bonuses
mechanics: Basic Attack - Stringblade, Severing Note: Ascendant, and Dodge Counter - Stringblade use the stated Sheathed or Drawn Stances; these stances determine Qin Heart and Sword Cadence generation.
Sword Glide replaces Dodge while Qingxiao is airborne.
Formless Heart Sword attribute bonuses: Crit. DMG +2.40%, then Crit. DMG +5.60%.
Severing Note attribute bonuses: ATK +1.80%, then ATK +4.20%.
Billows Beneath Heaven attribute bonuses: ATK +1.80%, then ATK +4.20%.

sequences.name: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart
effects: Crit. Rate +16%.
Swordlight Ward maximum stacks become 2; Heavy Attack - Stringblade additionally grants 1 stack.
Enter combat with 25 Exorcising Seal stacks.

After specified Basic or Mid-air attacks damage an enemy while Exorcising Seal is present, consume 1 Seal to trigger Juque Perdition for 400% ATK Aero DMG, treated as Basic Attack DMG; once per second.
Each Seal consumed makes the target take 4% more Juque Perdition damage for 1 second; Exorcising Seal caps at 25.

sequences.name: Like Petals That Fall Without a Sound
effects: Heavy Attack - Stringblade damage multiplier +40%.
Nearby enemies' Mindlock cap becomes 25 after entering combat.
Gathered Mind cap becomes 25.
Enhanced Heaven's Clarity makes Heavy Attack - Stringblade inflict 6 Mindlock stacks on nearby targets.

sequences.name: Dreams Fade, Sword Abides
effects: Billows Beneath Heaven Crit. DMG +100%.
Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants World in Chorus stacks equal to the highest nearby Mindlock count.
Each stack increases Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence's damage multiplier by 3%; stacks are removed after that attack.
Gathered Mind inflicts 2 Tune Strain - Interfered stacks instead of 1.

sequences.name: Wherever the Road Leads, Side by Side
effects: After a team Resonator inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, that Resonator gains 20% ATK for 8 seconds.

sequences.name: Cold Steel That Longs to Warm the Snow
effects: Severing Note: Judgement damage multiplier +100%.
Flight Qi cost while moving in Sword Flight -30%.

sequences.name: Cleanse This Tarnished Age, Till All Runs Clear
effects: Targets take 40% more damage from the listed Qingxiao attacks.
Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants Exorcising Seal stacks equal to the highest nearby Mindlock count.
Juque Perdition damage is amplified by 2% per target Mindlock stack, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
With To Know, To Banish unlocked, Juque Perdition against Mindlocked targets gains a further 2% damage increase per Mindlock stack, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
Response to Tune Strain - Interfered is increased by 20%.

gaps: The evidence does not provide exact damage values for many effects beyond the listed Skill Detail tables, nor exact durations for Ephemeral Transcendence, Heaven's Clarity, Sword Flight, Resonant Chime, Mindlock, or Swordlight Ward beyond the stated 1-second damage-reduction duration.
The evidence mentions Flight Qi but provides no maximum, regeneration, or numeric consumption rate; only S5's 30% reduction is specified.
The evidence names Sword Dodge as a Sword Flight entry skill but does not provide a separate Sword Dodge ability description or damage/table row.
The exact meaning of 'additional Off-Tune Level' and the amount built by the enhanced Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning are not specified.
The source labels Resonance Chain effects as S1-S6 and supplies their names/effects, but does not provide separate numerical damage tables for Juque Perdition or World in Chorus.
No separate standalone numeric table is supplied for Tune Break, Inherent Skills, Outro Skill, or the extra movement/state mechanics; unsupported values are therefore omitted.

abilities.name: Unraveled Spring
mechanics: Zephyr Stance Basic Attack: Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it to perform up to 4 consecutive Glacio attacks. Each hit restores Cloud Breath.
Zephyr Stance Mid-air Attack: Consume Stamina to perform a plunging Glacio attack.
Zephyr Stance Dodge Counter: Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack with Glacio DMG and restore Cloud Breath on hit.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance to perform Zephyr Stance Basic Attack Stage 4.
While in Drizzle Stance, Zephyr Stance Basic Attack is replaced by Drizzle Stance Basic Attack.
Drizzle Stance Basic Attack: Press Normal Attack repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive Glacio attacks; each hit restores Floral Epistle. Stage 3 continuously pulls nearby targets.
Drizzle Stance Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts Glacio Chafe once on hit.
Drizzle Stance Heavy Attack: Consume Stamina to attack with Glacio DMG and restore Floral Epistle on hit.
Illuminating Dew: While in Drizzle Stance, continue holding Normal Attack after Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance to perform a Stamina-consuming plunging Glacio attack.
Swallow's Cut: While in Drizzle Stance, either release Normal Attack during Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance or press Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Stamina-consuming plunging Glacio attack.
In Drizzle Stance, pressing Normal Attack within the specified timing after a successful Dodge triggered through Dodge - Parting Mist performs Drizzle Stance Basic Attack Stage 1.
In Drizzle Stance, a successful Dodge during Dodge - Parting Mist restores Floral Epistle and does not reset the Drizzle Stance Basic Attack cycle for a certain period.

abilities.name: Vernal Screen
mechanics: Zephyr Stance Skill: While in Zephyr Stance and Cloud Breath is not full, thrust forward and deal Glacio DMG. If Suisui is active when it is cast, restore Cloud Breath. The skill can be cast mid-air close to the ground.
Zephyr Stance Skill and Drizzle Stance Skill share a cooldown.

Awakening Spring: While in Zephyr Stance with full Cloud Breath, this replaces Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance. Casting it consumes all Cloud Breath, pulls nearby targets, enters Drizzle Stance, deals Glacio DMG, and inflicts Glacio Chafe once on hit.

Enrichment: Casting Awakening Spring or Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade grants all nearby team Resonators 1 Enrichment stack. This can occur once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive Suisui's healing at the cost of Enrichment.

Drizzle Stance Skill: While in Drizzle Stance, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced by this skill. Thrust forward for Glacio DMG; if Suisui is active when cast, restore Floral Epistle. It can be cast mid-air close to the ground and shares a cooldown with the Zephyr Stance Skill.

abilities.name: Lambent Gold
mechanics: Zephyr Stance is Suisui's default state.

Cloud Breath has a maximum of 120 points. In Zephyr Stance, Zephyr Stance Basic Attacks and Zephyr Stance Dodge Counter restore it on hit; Zephyr Stance Resonance Skill restores 40 points if Suisui is active; and a successful Dodge during Dodge - Parting Mist restores 35 points.
At full Cloud Breath, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance becomes Awakening Spring.

Drizzle Stance: Entering this state clears all Floral Epistle. Suisui gains new combat actions and increased resistance to interruption. Drizzle Stance lasts 15s, then ends and clears all Floral Epistle.

Floral Epistle has a maximum of 600 points. Drizzle Stance Basic Attacks and Heavy Attacks restore it on hit; Drizzle Stance Resonance Skill restores 100 points if Suisui is active; and a successful Dodge during Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102 points.

Dodge - Parting Mist: While attacking on the ground, press Dodge at the cost of Stamina. Its successful Dodge restores Cloud Breath in Zephyr Stance or Floral Epistle in Drizzle Stance. In Zephyr Stance, pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Zephyr Stance Dodge Counter.
Drizzle Stance Heavy Attack, Illuminating Dew, and Swallow's Cut are the Stamina-consuming actions described under Normal Attack.

Inflicting Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, or Aero Erosion, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG, increases the target's maximum stack limit for that corresponding Negative Status by 3 for 15s. This does not stack.
Inflicting Electro Flare or dealing Electro Flare DMG increases the target's maximum stack limits for both Electro Flare and Electro Rage by 3 for 15s. This does not stack.

abilities.name: Rippling Waters
mechanics: Grants team Resonators 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent.
Exits Drizzle Stance, consumes all Floral Epistle, and applies effects based on the amount consumed.
At 0 Floral Epistle: grants all nearby team Resonators Reflecting Shadows for 6s; Reflecting Shadows increases resistance to interruption.
At least 200 Floral Epistle: if Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui can perform the first Plume Step within the applicable timing during Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 400 Floral Epistle: during Roaming Transcendent, the active Resonator inside Ceaseless Landscape deals increased DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen above 200%, this increases DMG by 0.2%, up to 12%. If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui can perform a second Plume Step within the applicable timing.

At least 600 Floral Epistle: when Suisui performs the first Plume Step, nearby active team Resonators inside Ceaseless Landscape gain the following for the duration of Roaming Transcendent: when they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When a Resonator with Undulating Mist consumes Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain ATK; for every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen above 200%, ATK increases by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts 14s or until that Resonator switches off-field; removing it also removes the ATK increase. If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui can perform a third Plume Step within the applicable timing.
Roaming Transcendent lasts 30s. During it, Suisui merges with Ceaseless Landscape and performs Transcendent Dance, with Plume Steps occurring at intervals based on Floral Epistle consumed.
If Suisui becomes the active Resonator, she stops Transcendent Dance. If Ceaseless Landscape is no longer active, she exits Roaming Transcendent.

Each Plume Step grants nearby team Resonators Reflecting Shadows for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within Ceaseless Landscape, and heals nearby active team Resonators within Ceaseless Landscape.

abilities.name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
mechanics: Sword Stance Flow - Azure: When Melody is depleted in Feather Sword Stance, Feather's Edge is replaced by this skill. It deals Havoc Heavy Attack DMG, restores 100 Melody and 1 Azure Plume, and consumes 1 Havoc Bane stack from each target hit. The Feather Sword Stance Basic Attack cycle is not reset for a short time. If the cycle resets, a Wraith of Sound completes the current attack with a fixed Havoc instance classified as Basic Attack DMG; it is unaffected by DMG Bonus effects and does not apply Havoc Bane. A successful Dodge can be triggered during the action and consumes 50 Melody.

Sword Stance Flow - Feather: When Melody is depleted in Azure Sword Stance, Feather's Edge is replaced by this skill. It switches to Feather Sword Stance, deals Havoc Heavy Attack DMG, restores 100 Melody and 1 Azure Plume, and consumes 1 Havoc Bane stack from each target hit. The Feather Sword Stance Basic Attack cycle is not reset for a short time. If the cycle resets, a Wraith of Sound completes the current attack with a fixed Havoc instance classified as Basic Attack DMG; it is unaffected by DMG Bonus effects and does not apply Havoc Bane. A successful Dodge can be triggered during the action and consumes 50 Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance: At maximum Azure Plume in Azure Sword Stance, holding Normal Attack consumes Stamina and all Azure Plume to create a large cyclone dealing Havoc Heavy Attack DMG. It applies 2 Havoc Bane stacks. When cast, Bated Breath is gained if Yangyang is active; this increases the attack's Crit. DMG by 160%. Bated Breath is removed when the attack ends and can be gained once every 25s.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance: At maximum Azure Plume in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang is grounded and not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, holding Normal Attack consumes Stamina and performs Havoc DMG. On hitting a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast. Casting Sword Stance Flow - Feather grants Streaming Storm for 15s. While Yangyang is active, the next Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom gains 160% Crit. DMG. Streaming Storm is removed when Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or its Dodge Counter Stage 3 ends. The source names the once-per-25s effect as Streaming Storm in this section, although it also refers to Drifting Mist. This attack applies 2 Havoc Bane stacks.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall: At maximum Azure Plume in Feather Sword Stance while airborne, this replaces Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance. Switching to another Resonator automatically casts it. Pressing or holding Normal Attack consumes Stamina and all Azure Plume to deal Havoc DMG, then enters Hark the Wind for 12s.

Hark the Wind: While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance becomes Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. It consumes Stamina and performs up to 3 Heavy Attack-class Havoc stages. Stages 2 and 3 can be used in mid-air near the ground. Stage 3 ends the cycle, and the cycle cannot be reset. A Dodge Counter counts toward the cycle.

Feathered Oath: When a nearby team Resonator applies Havoc Bane, Yangyang gains 1 stack for 4s, once per second, up to 6 stacks. While Yangyang is active, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by 25%, up to 150%.

Refrain: Before Azure Basic Attack Stage 4, Feather Basic Attack Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure, or Heavy Attack - Feather hits, the highest Havoc Bane stack count among targets in range is recorded and propagated to all targets in range.

Melody: Maximum 100 points. Sword Stance Flow - Azure and Sword Stance Flow - Feather restore 100 Melody. Resonance Liberation consumes all Melody. Normal Attacks consume Melody when they deal damage. Dodge windows during Sword Stance Switch - Azure, Sword Stance Switch - Feather, Sword Stance Flow - Azure, and Sword Stance Flow - Feather consume 50 Melody.

Azure Plume: Maximum 2 points. Sword Stance Flow - Azure, Sword Stance Flow - Feather, and Intro Skill - Skybound Feather each restore 1 point. Resonance Liberation restores 1 point. Heavy Attack - Azure and Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consume all Azure Plume.

abilities.name: Snapshot
mechanics: Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks that deal Glacio DMG.
During Basic Attack Stage 3, holding Normal Attack deploys Focus Ring. A cursor moves around the ring.
Releasing Normal Attack outside Perfect Focus performs Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring 25 Trace.
Releasing Normal Attack within Perfect Focus performs Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring 50 Trace.
Pressing Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 2 performs Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable instead of deploying Focus Ring.
While Focus Ring is active, the Perfect Focus zone continues filling the ring. When the ring is fully filled, it automatically collapses and triggers Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Holding Normal Attack performs Basic Attack Stages 1, 2, and 3 in sequence and deploys Focus Ring during Stage 3.
Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina to perform a plunging attack that deals Glacio DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Basic Attack Stage 2.
Dodge Counter: pressing Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge attacks the target for Glacio DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Basic Attack Stage 3.
quantitative_details: Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable DMG: 80.25% (skill Lv.1)
Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable DMG: 118.34% (skill Lv.1)

abilities.name: Phantom Frame
mechanics: Pulls in nearby targets and deals Glacio DMG.
Holding Resonance Skill while casting deploys Focus Ring. A cursor moves around the ring.
Releasing Resonance Skill outside Perfect Focus performs Compensate, dealing Glacio DMG, restoring 25 Trace, and reducing this skill's cooldown by 8 seconds.
Releasing Resonance Skill within Perfect Focus performs Spotlight, dealing increased Glacio DMG, restoring 50 Trace, and restoring 20 Concerto Energy.
Spotlight also inflicts 1 additional Glacio Chafe stack if Lucilla is in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe.
Spotlight is interruption-resistant. Switching to another Resonator during Spotlight ends the skill early.
If cast on-field without holding Resonance Skill, Phantom Frame directly performs Compensate.
Pressing Normal Attack shortly after Phantom Frame performs Basic Attack Stage 2.

abilities.name: Memory Palace
mechanics: Trace: Lucilla can hold up to 150 Trace.
Casting Intro Skill - Clip It restores 100 Trace.
Spotlight restores 50 Trace.
Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable restores 50 Trace.
Compensate and Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable each restore 25 Trace.
Photos: Lucilla can hold up to 3 Photos. Every 50 Trace restored generates 1 Photo.
Oblivion occurs intermittently during Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3 and consumes 1 Photo per occurrence to deal 1 instance of Glacio DMG.
In Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Oblivion is classified as Basic Attack DMG and inflicts 1 Glacio Chafe stack.
In Resonance Mode - Echo, Oblivion is classified as Echo Skill DMG. Each Oblivion cast counts as casting a different Echo Skill.
Reminiscence is entered through Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day. During Reminiscence, Lucilla's resistance to interruption increases and she cannot cast Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation.
Basic Attack - Tracing Forms replaces Basic Attack during Reminiscence and performs up to 3 consecutive Glacio attacks classified as Basic Attack DMG.
Holding Normal Attack performs Tracing Forms Stages 1, 2, and 3 consecutively.
During Tracing Forms Stage 3, repeatedly pressing or holding Normal Attack performs continuous attacks.
Releasing Normal Attack or completing the entire Tracing Forms Stage 3 automatically performs Letting It Go.
Letting It Go deals Glacio DMG in an area. Its damage is classified as Basic Attack DMG in Glacio Chafe mode and Echo Skill DMG in Echo mode.
Lucilla is immune to interruption and damage during Letting It Go; switching Resonators is disabled during it.
Letting It Go restores 20 Concerto Energy and ends Reminiscence.
Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence consumes Stamina to plunge for Glacio DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Tracing Forms Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Reminiscence is triggered by pressing Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge, deals Glacio DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG, and pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Tracing Forms Stage 3.
Déjà Vu: When Clear As Day is cast in Glacio Chafe mode, gain 4 Film Roll stacks for 30 seconds; Film Roll can stack up to 4 times in this state and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
In Echo mode, Clear As Day grants 1 Zoom stack for 30 seconds; Zoom is limited to 1 stack in this state and is removed when the duration ends.
These Déjà Vu effects end early when Lucilla switches Resonance Mode.
Film Roll: when another active Resonator inflicts Glacio Chafe, consume 1 Film Roll to inflict Glacio Chafe twice on nearby targets. This can trigger once every 0.5 seconds.
Zoom: each stack increases the active Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. DMG by 10%.

Quick Glance: pressing Aim enters camera mode. Reverberations, environmental collectibles, and special collectibles within range of Lucilla's shot are marked. Pressing the shutter captures the moment and gathers the marked items.

abilities.name: Locked Thread
mechanics: Basic Attack: Performs up to 4 consecutive Spectro DMG attacks.
Holding Normal Attack after Basic Attack Stage 1 performs a continuous attack. Holding Normal Attack for a certain time casts Heavy Attack Stage 1.
Holding Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands casts Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack: Consumes Stamina to lash enemies with Monowire for Spectro DMG. Holding Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 casts Heavy Attack Stage 2; pressing Normal Attack shortly after Heavy Attack Stage 1 instead casts Basic Attack Stage 3.
Mid-air Attack: Consumes Stamina for a plunging Spectro attack. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter: Pressing Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge deals Spectro DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack Stage 4; holding Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Heavy Attack Stage 2.
While in Algorithm Compaction, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack - Thread Shredding: up to 4 consecutive attacks, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

While in Algorithm Compaction, Heavy Attack becomes Heavy Attack - Single Threading: consumes Stamina to attack for Spectro DMG. While airborne, pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction; while grounded, it casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

While in Algorithm Compaction and at 100 Root Access, Heavy Attack - Single Threading becomes Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. This consumes Stamina and all Root Access for Spectro DMG. Pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly afterward while airborne casts Heavy Attack - Multi-threading; while grounded, it casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

abilities.name: Netrunner / Old Net Deep Dive
mechanics: Netrunner opens Protocol Interface for 10s and starts with 24 RAM. Up to 7 distinct Spoofing Programs can be selected, each consuming RAM.
While the interface is active, Lucy marks targets in view. Selected programs affect marked targets. The view can be adjusted to mark more targets; no program can be applied if no target is in view.

When the duration ends or Normal Attack is held, Override deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets and closes the interface; Override is Heavy Attack DMG. If RAM is exhausted or insufficient for any program, pressing Normal Attack triggers Override on all marked targets.
Can be cast airborne near the ground.
Ping costs 2 RAM, extends the field of view, and automatically marks and deals Spectro DMG to nearby targets in range; Heavy Attack DMG.
Cyberwave Malfunction costs 4 RAM and makes marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.
Breach Protocol costs 4 RAM and reduces marked targets' DEF by 5% for 30s.
Synapse Burnout costs 5 RAM and deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets in range; Heavy Attack DMG.
Cripple Movement costs 6 RAM, deals Hack DMG to all marked targets, and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.
Weapon Glitch costs 5 RAM and gives marked targets' attacks a chance to be reduced by 100% for 30s.
Cyberpsychosis costs 6 RAM, converts marked targets to neutral units, and reduces their Vibration Strength; it only works on Common-class enemies.

After Multi-threading during Algorithm Compaction, Netrunner becomes Old Net Deep Dive. Old Net Deep Dive has all Netrunner effects but greatly increases Override's DMG Multiplier. After it is cast or Lucy leaves Algorithm Compaction, it becomes Netrunner again. It can also be cast airborne near the ground.

Foreclaimed Self Basic Attack Stages 3, 4, and 5 each apply 1 Glacio Chafe on hit.

Foreclaimed Self Heavy Attack enters Hold Breath while Normal Attack is held, continuously consuming Stamina. Releasing Normal Attack or exhausting Stamina ends Hold Breath and makes Hiyuki thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Pressing Normal Attack shortly after Foreclaimed Self Heavy Attack performs Basic Attack Stage 2. If Hiyuki is hit during the thrust, she negates that damage instance, Stagnates nearby targets, becomes interruption-resistant for a period, and reduces incoming DMG by 100%. Pressing Normal Attack within the follow-up window can instead chain into Stage 4.

When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Foreclaimed Self Heavy Attack becomes Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self. Holding Normal Attack consumes Stamina and 3 Whiteout Bitterfrost to gain 1 Snowforged Blade and deal Glacio DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. It applies 1 Glacio Chafe on hit.
Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self makes Hiyuki land before execution if she is airborne.

Foreclaimed Self Mid-air Attack replaces Present Self Mid-air Attack. It consumes Stamina for up to 3 consecutive aerial attacks; Stage 3 is a plunging attack. Stages 2 and 3 apply 1 Glacio Chafe each. This aerial combo is not reset by skills other than Basic Attack - Iai within a short period.
While airborne in Foreclaimed Self, holding Normal Attack performs a Stamina-consuming plunging attack.

Foreclaimed Self Dodge Counter replaces Present Self Dodge Counter, deals Glacio DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG, and can chain into Foreclaimed Self Basic Attack Stage 3 shortly after casting.
Frost Splinter: Present Self restores Dedication through its final arrow and makes Foreclaiming: Inward Vision available.

mechanics: Present Self Resonance Skill deals Glacio DMG and enhances the next Present Self Basic Attack Stage 3. The enhanced attack restores 100 Dedication when cast; switching out ends the enhancement.

Pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly after the skill performs Present Self Basic Attack Stage 3. If Dedication is below 300, holding Normal Attack within the follow-up period performs that attack.
In Foreclaimed Self, the skill is replaced by Jade Cleave on the ground and Petalfall in mid-air.

abilities.name: Everfrost Dominion
mechanics: Glacio Bite conversion: While Hiyuki is in the team, nearby team Resonators' Glacio Chafe is converted to Glacio Bite. Each new Glacio Bite stack triggers one Glacio Bite DMG instance based on the target's current Glacio Bite stack limit. Glacio Bite can affect frozen targets, counts as Glacio Chafe, and its damage counts as Glacio Chafe DMG.
When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits a target with at least 10 Glacio Bite stacks, 10 stacks are consumed and Frostbind is triggered once.
When Hiyuki joins the team, all target Glacio Chafe stacks are removed. When she leaves, all Glacio Bite stacks are cleared unless another team Resonator can convert Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite.
Present Self: Hiyuki starts in this state. Certain skills restore Dedication.
Foreclaimed Self: Entered after Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. This form restores Frostheart through specified attacks.

Iai Stance requires at least 100 Frostheart. After eligible Foreclaimed Self Normal Attacks, Jade Cleave, Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, or Intro Skill - Frostedge, pressing Dodge can make Hiyuki flash backward, consume Stamina, and enter Iai Stance. Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed, Jade Cleave, Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, and Frostedge are excluded from the relevant Dodge trigger.

Within the specified window after Jade Cleave or Petalfall, holding Resonance Skill can also enter Iai Stance. With a valid target in range and forward input held, Hiyuki flashes behind the enemy instead.
Hiyuki may enter Iai Stance in mid-air. Entering it resets mid-air Dodge charges. Switching out ends Iai Stance.

Basic Attack - Iai is available shortly after entering Iai Stance. It consumes 100 Frostheart and deals Glacio DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. If at least 100 Frostheart remains, another Basic Attack - Iai can be cast during the follow-up window.
If Hiyuki is hit during Basic Attack - Iai, she negates that damage instance, becomes interruption-resistant afterward, and reduces incoming DMG by 100%.
Each Basic Attack - Iai consumes 1 Frostharden Iai if available, applies 3 Glacio Chafe stacks, and grants 1 Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Dedication has a maximum of 300. In Present Self, Present Self Basic Attack Stage 3 restores 100 Dedication; Intro Skill - Frostedge restores 200. The Resonance Skill enhancement adds another 100 Dedication restoration to the next Present Self Basic Attack Stage 3.
Frostheart has a maximum of 300. It is restored by Jade Cleave, Petalfall, and Foreclaimed Self Normal Attacks other than Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self.
Frostharden Iai has a maximum of 3. Foreclaiming: Inward Vision grants 3.
Whiteout Bitterfrost has a maximum of 3. Each Frostharden Iai consumed by Basic Attack - Iai grants 1 stack.
Snowforged Blade has a maximum of 3. Each Foreclaimed Self Heavy Attack grants 1 stack.
Glacio Chafe applied by Hiyuki or nearby Resonators is subject to the Glacio Bite conversion while she is present.

abilities.name: Fine Snow
mechanics: Whenever a team Resonator applies Glacio Chafe or Havoc Bane, Hiyuki gains 1 Snow Rust stack. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once; Snow Rust has a maximum of 3 stacks.
At 1 Snow Rust, while Hiyuki is active, Glacio Bite DMG against targets in the specified range is amplified by 30%, and Hiyuki gains 40% Crit. DMG.
At 2 Snow Rust, while Hiyuki is active, every Glacio Chafe application by Hiyuki additionally deals one Glacio Bite DMG instance with a fixed 102% multiplier.
At 3 Snow Rust, the active-Hiyuki Glacio Bite DMG amplification gains another 30% against targets in the specified range.
Snow Rust resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

abilities.name: Ephemeral Realm
mechanics: After Hiyuki leaves combat or recovers from being knocked out, if she remains out of combat for 4 seconds with fewer than 1 Snowforged Blade, she restores 1 Snowforged Blade.

abilities.name: Foreclaiming
mechanics: Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available after Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.

In Present Self, press Resonance Liberation to cast it. It deals Glacio DMG, applies 4 Glacio Chafe stacks, grants 3 Frostharden Iai, removes 300 Dedication and all Frostheart, enters Foreclaimed Self, and restores 50 Frostheart. It does not consume Resonance Energy.

In Foreclaimed Self, Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation can be cast by pressing and releasing Resonance Liberation. If Hiyuki has 3 Snowforged Blade, all 3 are consumed; otherwise this cast consumes none.

Holding Resonance Liberation enters a charge state that periodically consumes 1 Snowforged Blade. Releasing casts Blade Liberation. If no blade was consumed on release, charging continues and the skill is automatically cast after a period. Blade Liberation also casts automatically when Snowforged Blade reaches zero.
Each Snowforged Blade consumed increases Blade Liberation's DMG multiplier. Casting it consumes 300 Dedication and Frostheart and ends Foreclaimed Self.

mechanics: Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes consumes 2 Runes and deals Aero DMG classified as Echo Skill DMG.
When the consumed Runes are one Rune: Trust and one Rune: Answer, Schemata of Runes gains Runic Outburst.
When both consumed Runes are Rune: Trust, it gains Runic Chain Whip.
When both consumed Runes are Rune: Answer, it gains Runic Soliskin.

If Sigrika has at least 30 Soliskin Vitality when consuming Runes, 30 Vitality is consumed and the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin damage multipliers are increased by 50%. This also grants 1 stack of Innate Gift?.

If Soliskin Vitality is below 30 when Runes are consumed, all current Soliskin Vitality is consumed. Each 10 points consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.
Runic Outburst deals Aero DMG and is classified as Echo Skill DMG.
Runic Chain Whip deals Aero DMG classified as Echo Skill DMG and Stagnates nearby targets.
Runic Soliskin deals Aero DMG classified as Echo Skill DMG and pulls nearby targets inward.
After Schemata of Runes, Sigrika gains 50 Full Stop, up to 100.

When Full Stop reaches 100 and Learn My True Name is not on cooldown, pressing Resonance Skill casts either BOOMY BOOM! or Soliskin to the Aid. Holding Resonance Skill consumes all Full Stop to cast Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, dealing Aero DMG classified as Echo Skill DMG.
Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name has a 25-second cooldown and restores 10 Concerto Energy.

Sigrika can hold up to 2 Innate Gift? stacks. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification. This effect ends after Learn My True Name is cast or Sigrika leaves the field.

Sigrika normally holds up to 4 Runes. Without Full Stop, she can hold only 2 Runes. When gaining a Rune at maximum capacity, all Runes shift one slot left and the leftmost Rune is removed. With at least 50 Full Stop, she can hold 2 additional Runes.
Basic Attack - Elucidated and Dodge Counter - Decipher directly hitting a target grant Rune: Trust.
BIG BOOMY BOOM! and Soliskin to the Aid directly hitting a target grant Rune: Answer.

When a nearby team Resonator casts an Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 Soliskin Vitality, up to 60. Echoes with the same name trigger this gain only once. Casting Outro Skill - In This Very Moment resets the record of Echoes that triggered it.

Gavel of Earthshaker is unavailable after Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is cast or Luuk Herssen leaves the field.

With full Ichor Flow, enter Aureate Judge. Ichor Flow no longer restores in this state, all Aureole of Execution forms gain 110% DMG Multiplier, and casting Glare increases the next Gavel of Earthshaker and Ichor Deposit DMG Multipliers by 110%. Each Aureole of Execution cast consumes 100 Ichor Flow. Aureate Judge ends when Ichor Flow is depleted.

Golden Rule: while Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other team Resonators gain Golden Rule. When a Golden Rule Resonator casts an Outro Skill and Luuk Herssen is the incoming Resonator, remove all Golden Rules from the team, grant Luuk Herssen 200 Ichor Flow and 12 Concerto Energy, and allow the team to regain Golden Rule after 24s. This effect does not function in Co-op Mode.

Dawnlit Keep: gain 1 stack after staying out of combat for more than 4s or casting Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn. It is capped at 1 stack. When hit by an enemy, consume 1 stack to reduce DMG taken by 60% and grant interruption immunity for 1s. This can trigger once per second.

Radiant Reave: while airborne, Dodge briefly keeps Luuk Herssen airborne and throws an Ichor Blade. It continuously consumes Stamina. If launched airborne, Dodge before landing can trigger this effect up to 3 times. The trigger count resets when grounded or switched out for more than 3s.

Ichor Blade deals fixed Spectro DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG and is unaffected by DMG Bonuses. Only one can exist at once; it cannot trigger Counterattack and cannot launch without a nearby target. It disappears when Luuk Herssen casts another damaging skill or leaves the field.

Ichor Flow has a maximum of 300 points. Normal Attacks, Golden Reflux, Aureole of Execution, Golden Impale and Gavel of Earthshaker restore it on hit. Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn restores 100 points.

abilities.name: To Sculpt the Silence
mechanics: Seraphic Duo: Casting Aemeath or Mech Basic Attack Stage 4 enters Seraphic Duo for 5 seconds.

Seraphic Duet: Overture: While in Aemeath form, Seraphic Duo is active, and Synchronization Rate is at least 100, Resonance Skill consumes 100 Synchronization Rate to deal Fusion DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. It can be cast mid-air, switches to Mech, exits Seraphic Duo, and permits a timely Normal Attack to cast Mech Basic Attack Stage 2.

Seraphic Duet: Encore: While in Mech form under the same conditions, Resonance Skill consumes 100 Synchronization Rate to deal Fusion DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. It can be cast mid-air, switches to Aemeath, exits Seraphic Duo, and permits a shortly-following Normal Attack to cast Aemeath Basic Attack Stage 2.
Resonance Mode—Tune Rupture: When the team triggers Tune Rupture—Interfered, inflict 10 Rupturous Trail stacks on the target for 30 seconds, up to 30 stacks.

Resonance Mode—Fusion Burst: When the team inflicts Fusion Burst, inflict 1 Fusion Trail stack for 30 seconds, up to 30 stacks. When nearby targets' Fusion Burst reaches 0 stacks during combat, inflict 1 Fusion Burst stack. If a target has more than 5 Fusion Burst stacks, trigger Fusion Burst using its maximum stack limit and remove all stacks.

In either Resonance Mode, the listed Aemeath and Mech Basic Attack Stages 3-4, Sync Strike skills, and the listed Intro Skills can inflict the mode's corresponding response on damage, once per skill per target every 3 seconds.

In Tune Rupture mode, Seraphic Duet removes Rupturous Trail from nearby targets and adds five Tune Rupture DMG instances, each against a random target in range. Each removed Rupturous Trail stack increases Seraphic Duet's additional-instance DMG Multiplier against that target by 4% for 1 second. Off-Tune Level does not affect these instances.

In Fusion Burst mode, Seraphic Duet removes Fusion Trail from affected targets and triggers Fusion Burst at the target's maximum stack limit without removing its stacks. Each removed Fusion Trail stack increases main-target Fusion Burst DMG Multiplier by 10%.
During Stardust Resonance, Tune Rupture mode Seraphic Duet additionally deals 10 Tune Rupture DMG instances.
During Stardust Resonance, Fusion Burst triggered on the main target by Seraphic Duet gains an additional 200% DMG Multiplier; this stacks with the Fusion Trail increase.
Tune Rupture Response—Starburst: In Tune Rupture mode, deal Fusion DMG to targets affected by Tune Rupture—Interfered; this is considered Tune Rupture DMG.
Starflux Thrust: In Mech form with more than 200 Starflux, use the Utility button to launch into the air while continuously consuming Starflux.

Synchronization Rate is capped at 200. Aemeath/Mech Basic Attacks, Mid-air Attacks, Dodge Counters, and both Sync Strikes recover it. Songs Across the Universe and Debut of Meteoric Radiance recover 40; Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive recovers 30; while Instant Response and Heavenfall Edict: Unbound are both active, either Charged II recovers 200.
Resonance Rate is capped at 4. Seraphic Duet and Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive each recover 1; Overdrive additionally recovers 1 during Starlume Acceleration.
Starflux is capped at 600 and recovers naturally over time.

abilities.name: Resolution
mechanics: Expectation Error heals all nearby team Resonators and places Mornye in the Parry state. During Parry, damage taken is reduced by 100% for a period. Switching Resonators ends Parry immediately.
If Mornye is attacked during Parry, Parry ends and Optimal Solution is cast. If she is not attacked, pressing Normal Attack ends Parry and casts Basic Attack Stage 2.
Optimal Solution stagnates nearby targets, deals Fusion DMG, and reduces Expectation Error's cooldown by 2 seconds. Switching Resonators ends Stagnation early.
Distributed Array replaces Resonance Skill during Wide Field Observation Mode. It heals all nearby team Resonators and summons Hover Cannons to strike the target for Fusion DMG.

abilities.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
mechanics: Baseline Mode: Mornye gains Rest Mass Energy while in her default mode.
Rest Mass Energy: Holds up to 100. It is gained in Baseline Mode from Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, or Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution hitting a target.

Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift: At 100 Rest Mass Energy, Heavy Attack is replaced by this attack. It deals Fusion DMG treated as Heavy Attack DMG, then launches Mornye into mid-air, consumes all Rest Mass Energy, and enters Wide Field Observation Mode.

Wide Field Observation Mode: Lasts 30s and generates a Syntony Field on entry. Mornye gains Relative Momentum. If Relative Momentum is below 100 while Normal Attack is held, she performs Wide Field Observation Mode Basic Attack Stages 1-3 in sequence; if Relative Momentum reaches 100 during this sequence, Heavy Attack - Inversion is cast instead.

While in Wide Field Observation Mode, movement continuously consumes Stamina and Stamina cannot recover. Directional Dodging makes Mornye fly at speed for up to 10s, until Stamina is depleted, or until the mode ends.

When hit or launched into mid-air, pressing Dodge immediately recovers from the attack and counts as a successful Dodge. This can trigger up to 3 times and resets when Wide Field Observation Mode ends.

Pressing Jump makes Mornye descend slowly. Before landing, Wide Field Observation Mode Basic Attack, Distributed Array, and Heavy Attack - Inversion are unavailable. If Jump is pressed after Stamina runs out, Wide Field Observation Mode ends.
Wide Field Observation Mode also ends when Mornye Dodges, Jumps, performs a mid-air attack, performs an environmental interaction, uses a Utility, switches Resonators, or is no longer airborne.

Syntony Field lasts 25s. On creation it deals Fusion DMG treated as Resonance Liberation DMG. It continuously heals nearby team Resonators inside it once every 3s, increases their Off-Tune Buildup Rate by 50%, and increases their resistance to interruption.

Heavy Attack - Inversion: At 100 Relative Momentum, Heavy Attack is replaced by this attack. It consumes all Relative Momentum, deals Fusion DMG treated as Heavy Attack DMG, can be performed mid-air, and applies Observation Marker for 30s.

Relative Momentum: Holds up to 100. During Wide Field Observation Mode it is gained when Wide Field Observation Mode Basic Attack, Wide Field Observation Mode Dodge Counter, or Distributed Array hits a target. It cannot be gained during Heavy Attack - Inversion.
Observation Marker: When a team Resonator deals Tune Break DMG to a marked target, Mornye applies Interfered Marker for 8s.

Interfered Marker: Targets affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered or Tune Strain - Interfered take increased DMG from all nearby team Resonators. For each 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen above 100%, their DMG increases by 0.25%, up to 40%.

Visual Field: When a team Resonator defeats a target with Observation Marker or Interfered Marker, Mornye gains Visual Field for 3s. While active, any team Resonator dealing damage causes Mornye to apply Observation Marker to the hit target.
Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet: Deals one instance of Fusion DMG to targets within range that are in the Tune Rupture - Interfered state; this is treated as Tune Rupture DMG.

abilities.name: Chroma Drift
mechanics: Press or hold Normal Attack for up to 3 consecutive Spectro attacks.
Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina and deals Spectro damage.
Dodge Counter is performed by pressing Normal Attack immediately after a successful Dodge and deals Spectro damage.
With full Overflow during Optical Sampling Stage, hold Normal Attack to charge Spark Collision. Lynae is interruption-resistant and takes 50% less damage while charging.
During the charge, every 0.2s, 15 Overflow is converted into 12.5% Lumiflow.

Release Normal Attack, or fill Lumiflow, to cast Spark Collision. Its level depends on Lumiflow: Level 1 below 50%, Level 2 from 50% to below 100%, and Level 3 at 100%. Casting Spark Collision removes all Overflow.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Normal Attack is replaced by Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack, with up to 5 consecutive Spectro attacks.
With 120 Lumiflow, Kaleidoscopic Parade Basic Attack Stages 1 and 4 can track enemies from a greater distance.

While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, holding Normal Attack on the ground performs Ground Heavy Attack. It consumes Stamina for repeated attacks, considered Basic Attack damage; release casts Graffiti Blast, also considered Basic Attack damage.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, holding Normal Attack in mid-air performs Mid-air Heavy Attack, consuming Stamina and dealing Spectro damage; it is considered Basic Attack damage.
Mid-air Heavy Attack cannot gain new charges while airborne. Its available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and on the ground.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Mid-air Attack is replaced by Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack, which consumes Stamina for a plunging Spectro attack.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Dodge Counter is replaced by Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter. Press Normal Attack shortly after it to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

abilities.name: Chromaticity Modeling
mechanics: Optical Sampling Stage is Lynae's default state. Certain actions restore Overflow in this state.
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision enters Kaleidoscopic Parade.

During Kaleidoscopic Parade, Lumiflow continuously recovers while Lynae moves on the ground or during specified skill windows. Walking is disabled; Running and Sprinting become the faster Free Skating and Speed Skating.

Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap replaces Jump when Lumiflow is at least one-third of its maximum. It consumes one-third of maximum Lumiflow, deals Spectro damage, and inflicts Photochromic Flux. Successful Dodges can be triggered during the skill.
Polychrome Leap has up to 3 airborne stages; switching Resonators resets the combo. Each stage used in combat restores 1 True Color.
After Polychrome Leap Stage 1, pressing Normal Attack on the ground within the timing window casts Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2. Stage 2 also pulls nearby targets.

With 3 True Color while airborne, and while Visual Impact is on cooldown, pressing Normal Attack or Resonance Skill casts Iridescent Splash. It deals Spectro damage, inflicts Photochromic Flux, consumes 3 True Color, and allows Basic Attack Stage 2 if Normal Attack is pressed during its timing.

With 3 True Color while airborne, and Visual Impact available, pressing Normal Attack or Resonance Skill casts Visual Impact. It deals Spectro damage, inflicts Photochromic Flux, consumes 3 True Color, grants nearby team Resonators 40 Tune Break Boost for 30s, and allows Basic Attack Stage 2 if Normal Attack is pressed during its timing.
When Visual Impact is cast, it leaves Spray Paint on the ground through Inherent Skill 1.
Photochromic Flux from Polychrome Leap, Iridescent Splash, Visual Impact, and the Intro Skill activates the currently selected Resonance Mode.

Lynae can switch between Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture and Resonance Mode - Tune Strain. Tune Rupture mode applies Tune Rupture - Shifting for 25s; Tune Strain mode applies Tune Strain - Shifting for 25s.
Overflow maximum is 120. In Optical Sampling Stage, it recovers through Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter, or Intro Skill. Full Overflow enables Spark Collision.

Lumiflow maximum is 120. During Kaleidoscopic Parade, it restores at 20% per second while moving on the ground, climbing, or performing a successful ground Dodge, and during the listed Basic Attack, Ground Heavy Attack, Mid-air Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, Additive Color, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow! windows.

Lumiflow starts depleting at 20% per second while Lynae is stationary on the ground, climbing, swimming, or off-field, and after the specified windows following the listed skills. It is unchanged outside these conditions. Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all Lumiflow.
At 120 Lumiflow, roller-skating speed increases further. Speed Skating continuously consumes Stamina.

True Color maximum is 3. Each Polychrome Leap cast during combat grants 1 point. At 3 points, Iridescent Splash and Visual Impact become available. Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all True Color.
Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis deals Spectro damage, classified as Tune Rupture damage, to targets affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered.

abilities.name: Hexagram Calls, Lightning Falls
mechanics: Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks that deal Electro DMG.
Heavy Attack – Mountain Over Thunder: Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted Trigram – Mountain and Trigram – Thunder, in that order, and deal Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack – Thunder Over Mountain: Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted Trigram – Thunder and Trigram – Mountain, in that order. Deals a small amount of Electro DMG and additionally reduces the target’s Vibration Strength.
Heavy Attack – Twin Mountains: Hold Normal Attack to consume two highlighted Trigrams – Mountain from left to right. Heals all nearby Resonators in the team.
Heavy Attack – Twin Thunders: Hold Normal Attack to consume two highlighted Trigrams – Thunder from left to right. Heals all nearby Resonators in the team once per second for 8s.

Heavy Attack – Ghost Gate Omen: If Normal Attack is held while Buling has fewer than 2 Trigrams, the divination fails. Buling becomes temporarily immobilized, loses all Trigrams, and loses 20% of her current HP. This HP loss does not occur when her current HP is below 1%.
Mid-air Attack: Consumes Stamina to perform an attack that deals Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter: Press Normal Attack immediately after a successful Dodge to perform Basic Attack Stage 3 and deal Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack after the Dodge Counter to perform Basic Attack Stage 4.
Trigram system: Buling can hold up to 4 Trigrams. When at maximum capacity, obtaining a new Trigram shifts all existing Trigrams one slot to the left and removes the original leftmost Trigram.
Trigram – Mountain is gained when Basic Attack Stage 2 deals damage.
Trigram – Thunder is gained when Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack deals damage.
Trigram – Thunder is also gained when Resonance Skill – In Shadow Thunder Stirs is cast.

abilities.name: Reign of Silence
mechanics: Basic Attack performs up to 2 consecutive Havoc attacks.
Press Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 2 to cast Rending Lunge.
Rending Lunge deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after it on the ground to cast Death Snip. Use or hold Normal Attack shortly after it in mid-air to cast Hanging Finality.

Death Snip opens the scissors for Havoc DMG, then snips after a delay for additional Havoc DMG and heals all nearby team Resonators. Normal Attack during Death Snip deals additional Havoc DMG; press Normal Attack again to snip immediately. Death Snip DMG is Resonance Liberation DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after Death Snip to cast Thread Withdrawn.
Thread Withdrawn deals Havoc DMG and enables successful Dodges within a certain time after casting.

Heavy Attack launches Chisa into the air, consumes Stamina, and deals Havoc DMG. It cannot be cast in Chainsaw Mode. Within a certain time afterward, press Normal Attack, or cast Lifethread - Glide and press Normal Attack before landing, to cast Hanging Finality. Hold Normal Attack before landing to cast Heavy Attack - Severed Facet.
Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina for a plunging Havoc attack. Outside Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Severed Facet deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Hanging Finality. If interrupted, hold Normal Attack before landing to recast it once before landing.
Hanging Finality consumes Stamina for a plunging Havoc attack. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting it on the ground to cast Death Snip.
Dodge Counter is cast by pressing Normal Attack immediately after a successful Dodge and deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Rending Lunge.

After a successful ground Dodge, hold Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction, which Stagnates the target and deals Havoc DMG. Outside Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air after casting it to cast Rending Lunge; this follow-up is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode. In Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
Normal Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet, Hanging Finality, and Dodge Counter variants are Havoc damage unless otherwise specified.
quantitative_details: Eye of Unraveling - Retraction DMG: 90.00% (skill Lv.1)

abilities.name: Fractured Composition
mechanics: Eye of Unraveling Stagnates the target and deals Havoc DMG. Outside Chainsaw Mode, pressing Normal Attack on the ground or using Normal Attack in mid-air after casting it casts Rending Lunge; this follow-up is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode. In Chainsaw Mode on the ground, pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Sawring - Blitz Stage 2. Eye of Unraveling can be cast in mid-air.
When Ring of Chainsaw is full while Chisa is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced by Serrated Loop.

Serrated Loop Stagnates targets, deals Havoc DMG, and pulls nearby targets inward. Casting it enters Chainsaw Mode and replaces Resonance Skill with Eye of Unraveling. Press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.

Hold Resonance Skill during Serrated Loop to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Releasing the button during the duration, or continuing to hold it for a certain period, casts Sawring - Blitz Stage 1.

mechanics: Unseen Snare marks a target for 30s. Chisa applies it by hitting a target with Resonance Skill, hitting a target within a certain period after Serrated Loop, hitting a target with Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction, or locking on to a target.
When a marked target takes direct damage from a Resonator, Chisa applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane, at most once every 2s.
Thread of Bane causes Chisa to ignore 18% of the DEF of targets affected by Unseen Snare.
Chainsaw Mode unlocks Sawring - Blitz, Sawring Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter. Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consume Ring of Chainsaw on hit.

Sawring - Blitz can chain up to 3 attacks and deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack to begin at Stage 1; hold it to begin at Stage 2. Holding Normal Attack during Stage 2 sustains the attack, and Stage 2 automatically proceeds to Stage 3.

During Stage 2, releasing Normal Attack or Dodging without directional input automatically casts Stage 2: Discordance. Successful Dodges can be triggered shortly after Discordance; press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Stage 3.
During Stage 3, holding Normal Attack sustains the attack and it automatically proceeds to Sawring - Eradication. Releasing Normal Attack casts Stage 3: Falltone.
Sawring - Blitz DMG and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter DMG are Resonance Liberation DMG.

Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter is cast with Normal Attack after a successful Dodge in Chainsaw Mode. Press Normal Attack afterward, or hold it until the attack ends, to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3. Releasing Normal Attack or Dodging without directional input casts Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance. This counter deals Resonance Liberation DMG.

Sawring - Eradication is cast after Stage 3: Falltone or after Sawring - Blitz/Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consumes all Ring of Chainsaw. It deals Havoc DMG and grants shields to all nearby team Resonators for 30s. Its DMG is Resonance Liberation DMG.

Each point of Ring of Chainsaw consumed by Sawring - Blitz or Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter increases the next Sawring - Eradication DMG multiplier; up to 100 points count. Casting Sawring - Eradication consumes all Ring of Chainsaw and ends Chainsaw Mode.

Chainsaw Fever starts at 100% in Chainsaw Mode. It rapidly depletes when Chisa does not deal damage. At 0, Chisa enters Burnout State and exits Chainsaw Mode. Damage, Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility, Intro Reverberance - Return, and Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone reset Chainsaw Fever in Chainsaw Mode.
In Burnout State, Ring of Chainsaw rapidly depletes. At 0, Chisa leaves Burnout State. Dealing damage or casting Moment of Nihility or Reverberance - Return also ends Burnout State.

Outside Chainsaw Mode, with more than 10 Lifethread - Jetstream, Chisa can consume 50 to cast Lifethread - Glide after specified aerial actions: Heavy Attack, Eye of Unraveling, Rending Lunge, Thread Withdrawn, or another Lifethread - Glide. It can pull nearby Unseen Snare-marked enemies, permits short weapon gliding while holding Dodge, and enables successful Dodges for a certain time.
Ring of Chainsaw has a maximum of 100. Normal Attacks and Eye of Unraveling grant it; Moment of Nihility grants 40 and Reverberance - Return grants 20.

Lifethread - Jetstream has a maximum of 100 and is gained continuously over time. Defeating a target grants 100. Exiting Chainsaw Mode resets it to maximum, and passive gain is disabled briefly after Lifethread - Glide.
While in Chainsaw Mode, Lifethread - Jetstream is replaced by Chainsaw Fever.

The additional Sawring - Eradication multiplier gained from Ring of Chainsaw consumption also increases by 120%. Casting Sawring - Eradication ends Woven Myriad - Convergence.

abilities.name: Through the Groves
mechanics: Press to dash forward for a distance while consuming Stamina, dealing Aero DMG classified as Echo Skill DMG.
If cast when an enemy attack is about to hit Qiuyuan, he becomes immune to that instance of damage, stagnates nearby enemies, and gains interruption immunity during the dash.
Switching to another Resonator removes the stagnation effect.
Undaunted Wayfarer: Hold the skill to dash forward while consuming Stamina and deal Aero DMG to the target, classified as Echo Skill DMG.
If no targets are nearby, Qiuyuan leaps and dashes through the air while continuously consuming Stamina until it runs out.
Releasing the skill ends the dash immediately and makes Qiuyuan land. If targets are nearby on landing, he deals Aero DMG to nearby targets, classified as Echo Skill DMG.

abilities.name: Verdant Edge

Each of To Teach, To Save, and To Sacrifice counts as an Echo Skill.
Inksplash of Mind ends when Swordster's Soliloquy is depleted.
Swordster's Soliloquy has a maximum of 600 points.
Gain 100 points by performing Basic Attack Stage 3.
Gain 100 points for each stage of Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash.
Gain 100 points by performing Dodge Counter.
Gain 400 points by performing Intro Skill.
Swordster's Soliloquy cannot be gained during Inksplash of Mind and is cleared when that state ends.

abilities.name: Beyond Threshold
mechanics: Threshold State is Galbrena's default state; she accumulates Afterflame and Sinflame in it.

Demon Hypostasis replaces Basic Attack, Volley of Death, Ashfall Barrage, Blood for Blood, and Encroach with Seraphic Execution, Flamewing Verdict, Hellsent Barrage, Purgatory Scourge, and Ravage. These replacement attacks consume Purging Flame on hit.

While in Demon Hypostasis, each Afterflame point increases the DMG of Seraphic Execution, Flamewing Verdict, Hellsent Barrage, Ravage, and Purgatory Scourge by 1.5%, up to 60%. Afterflame is removed when Demon Hypostasis ends.
Demon Hypostasis ends when Purging Flame is depleted or after more than 50 seconds.

Basic Attack — Seraphic Execution: Perform up to 5 Fusion attacks. Stages 1–3 are Heavy Attack DMG; Stages 4–5 are Echo Skill DMG. Consume Purging Flame on hit. After Stage 5, pressing Normal Attack performs Stage 3.

Heavy Attack — Flamewing Verdict: Consume STA for up to 3 consecutive Fusion attacks; consume Purging Flame on hit. Stage 3 is Echo Skill DMG. After Stage 1, Normal Attack performs Seraphic Execution Stage 2; after Stages 2–3, it performs Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack — Hellsent Barrage: While airborne, press Normal Attack to consume STA for Fusion aerial attacks classified as Heavy Attack DMG; hold it to fire continuously. Both consume Purging Flame on hit. Releasing the button performs a Plunging Attack, followed by Seraphic Execution Stage 3 when Normal Attack is pressed.
If Galbrena is interrupted during Hellsent Barrage without landing, she cannot immediately recast it.
Dodge Counter — Purgatory Scourge: After a successful Dodge, press Normal Attack for Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG. Press Normal Attack afterward to perform Seraphic Execution Stage 4.

Resonance Skill — Ravage: Dash forward and leap; flip backward after hitting the target, dealing Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG and consuming Purging Flame on hit. Ravage and Encroach share a cooldown.

Hellstride: While casting Galbrena's own skills on the ground, press Dodge to deal fixed Fusion DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG. It receives no DMG buffs, can trigger successful Dodges, cannot be cast consecutively, and does not reset attack cycles when cast within a short time.
Burning Drive: Casting Intro Skill, Hellstride, Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4, Encroach, Ascent of Malice, or Ravage grants 20% interruption resistance and 20% ATK for 4 seconds.

Afterflame: Maximum 40 points. In Threshold State, an allied Resonator's Echo Skill restores 8 points. Echoes with the same name can trigger this recovery only once; the effect resets when Galbrena exits Demon Hypostasis. All Afterflame is removed on exit.
Sinflame: Maximum 100 points. In Threshold State, hitting an enemy with Basic Attack, Volley of Death, Ashfall Barrage, Encroach, or Intro Skill — Hellflare Overload restores Sinflame.
Inherent Skill 1's Fated End effect can be inflicted by the listed Galbrena attacks, including these Forte attacks.
