abilities.name: Moon Steps
mechanics: Moonring Basic Attack performs up to 3 consecutive attacks that deal Aero DMG.
Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina to perform a plunging Aero attack.
Moonring Dodge Counter is performed by pressing Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge and deals Aero DMG. Pressing Normal Attack again shortly afterward casts Moonring Basic Attack Stage 3.
Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring enters Lunar Cycle - New Moon and causes Iuno to attack with Moonbow. This Heavy Attack can be cast in mid-air and is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
While in Lunar Cycle - New Moon, Moonbow Basic Attack performs up to 3 consecutive Aero attacks, considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and can be cast in mid-air.

While in Lunar Cycle - New Moon, Moonbow Dodge Counter is performed by pressing Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge. It deals Aero DMG, is considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and pressing Normal Attack again shortly afterward casts Moonbow Basic Attack Stage 3. It can be cast in mid-air.
In Lunar Cycle - Half Moon, Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow deals Aero DMG, is considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and switches Iuno to Lunar Cycle - New Moon.
In Lunar Cycle - New Moon, Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring deals Aero DMG, is considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and switches Iuno to Lunar Cycle - Half Moon.
Heavy Attack is replaced by Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness when Concerto Energy is full; its full effects are listed under Forte Circuit.

abilities.name: Foresight Fugue
mechanics: Pulse of Origins dashes forward and deals Aero DMG.
When Iuno is not in Lunar Cycle, Moonring Basic Attack Stage 3, Intro Skill, or Pulse of Origins replaces her Resonance Skill with Closing Refrain for 5 seconds.
Closing Refrain unleashes multiple strikes that deal Aero DMG and activates Lunar Cycle.
When Iuno is in Lunar Cycle - Half Moon, Resonance Skill is replaced with Unfinished Refrain. It unleashes multiple Aero strikes and shares a cooldown with Closing Refrain.

When Iuno is in Lunar Cycle - New Moon, Resonance Skill is replaced with Arc Beyond the Edge, which has 2 initial charges. It shifts Iuno's position and deals Aero DMG considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Directional input extends Arc Beyond the Edge's travel distance. If Iuno is hit or launched into mid-air, casting it immediately recovers her from the attack. It can be cast in mid-air.
Closing Refrain, Unfinished Refrain, and Arc Beyond the Edge restore Sentience as specified by the Forte Circuit.

abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
mechanics: Lunar Cycle is activated by Closing Refrain or Resonance Liberation. It lasts 15 seconds, begins in Half Moon by default, and can switch between Half Moon and New Moon through Heavy Attack - Flux.

While in Lunar Cycle, Jump is replaced by Heavy Attack - Flux, Stamina does not recover while Iuno is airborne, and movement becomes Meandering. Meandering continuously consumes Stamina while airborne.
Environmental interactions, Utilities, or holding Jump ends Lunar Cycle.

In Half Moon, Iuno attacks with Moonring and restores Sentience when attacks hit. Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow deals Aero DMG, counts as Resonance Liberation DMG, and changes the state to New Moon. It can be cast in mid-air.

In New Moon, Iuno attacks with Moonbow. Moonbow Basic Attacks, Moonbow Dodge Counter, and Arc Beyond the Edge consume Sentience to increase their damage multipliers, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby team Resonators.
In New Moon, Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring deals Aero DMG, counts as Resonance Liberation DMG, and changes the state to Half Moon. It can be cast in mid-air.

When Concerto Energy is full, Heavy Attack becomes Absolute Fullness. It ends Lunar Cycle, heals nearby team Resonators, deals nearby Aero DMG considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and creates a Full Moon Domain at Iuno's location. It can be cast in mid-air and can trigger once every 25 seconds.
Full Moon Domain lasts 30 seconds. Resonators inside periodically recover HP and Stamina. The domain's healing and Stamina recovery occur at the listed 5-second interval.
When a Resonator gains a Shield inside Full Moon Domain, they gain 1 stack of Blessing of the Wan Light; this trigger can occur once every 0.5 seconds.

Blessing of the Wan Light grants the receiving Resonator 4% all-DMG Amplification for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining a stack refreshes the duration, and the effect ends early if that Resonator leaves the field.
Sentience has a maximum of 100 points. Intro Skill restores 40, Resonance Liberation restores 60, and Closing Refrain or Unfinished Refrain restores 25.
Moonring Basic Attack, Moonring Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore Sentience on hit while Iuno is in Lunar Cycle. The amount is not provided in the evidence.
Moonbow Basic Attack and Moonbow Dodge Counter consume Sentience in New Moon to enhance damage, grant extra Concerto Energy, and heal nearby team Resonators. The exact Sentience cost is not provided.
Arc Beyond the Edge consumes Sentience in New Moon to enhance damage, grant extra Concerto Energy, and heal nearby team Resonators. The exact Sentience cost is not provided.

abilities.name: Hunter's Path
mechanics: Basic Attack: Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Heavy Attack - Steelclash: Consumes Stamina to attack and deal Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after this attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.
Mid-air Attack: Consumes Stamina to perform a plunging attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.
Dodge Counter: Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack and deal Electro DMG.
Mid-air Dodge Counter: Press Normal Attack after a successful mid-air Dodge to perform a plunging attack at the cost of Stamina, dealing Electro DMG.
Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep: When Prowess is full, Heavy Attack - Steelclash is replaced by this attack. It deals Electro DMG and consumes all Prowess.
During Thunderoar: Backstep, release or press Normal Attack again within a certain period to perform Thunderoar: Spinslash.
Thunderoar: Spinslash can be used if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after the preceding skill is interrupted.
Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash: Augusta whirls with her Broadblade and deals Electro DMG.
Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut: Press Jump when Prowess is full to perform this attack, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full while casting Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, press Resonance Skill or Jump to perform Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.

If Prowess is full while casting Heavy Attack - Steelclash or Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, release Normal Attack after a certain period, or press Normal Attack or Jump again, to perform Thunderoar: Uppercut. It deals Electro DMG and consumes all Prowess.
Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash: When Prowess is full, Dodge Counter is replaced by this attack. It deals Electro DMG and is treated as Heavy Attack DMG.

Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep: When Ascendancy is full, press Normal Attack after a successful ground Dodge to use this attack instead of Dodge Counter and Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash. It deals Electro DMG and is treated as Heavy Attack DMG.
During Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep, release or press Normal Attack again within a certain period to perform Thunderoar: Spinslash.
Thunderoar: Spinslash can be used if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after the preceding skill is interrupted.
Prowess: Augusta can hold up to 100 points.

Prowess is gained when Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Steelclash, Mid-air Attack, Mid-air Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, Dodge Counter, or Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash deals damage.
Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare fully restores Prowess.
The Normal Attack attribute nodes provide Crit. Rate bonuses.

Undying Sunlight: Leap can be cast again after a period following interruption. It deals Electro DMG and can only be cast in mid-air.

abilities.name: Sunward Conquest
mechanics: Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath: Press and release Resonance Liberation to sweep the Broadblade forward, dealing Electro DMG treated as Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Sword of Eternal Oath restores 40% Ascendancy.
Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: When Majesty reaches 2 stacks, hold Resonance Liberation to cast this version. It costs no Resonance Energy but consumes 2 Majesty stacks.
Casting Sublime is the Sun creates Ruler's Realm and puts Augusta into Sworn Allegiance for 7s.
During Sworn Allegiance, time is temporarily stopped and Resonator switching is disabled.
Only Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector, and Dodge can be performed during Sworn Allegiance. Mid-air Attack is available while airborne.
Augusta can walk on water during Sworn Allegiance without consuming Stamina.
Press or hold Normal Attack during Sworn Allegiance to cast Sunborne.
After Sunborne has been cast 9 times, press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to cast Everbright Protector.
Sunborne deals Electro DMG treated as Heavy Attack DMG.
Everbright Protector deals Electro DMG treated as Heavy Attack DMG, ends Sworn Allegiance, and later consumes all Crown of Wills stacks.
When Sworn Allegiance ends, Everbright Protector is automatically cast.
Hold Resonance Liberation during Sworn Allegiance to cast Everbright Protector early.
Environmental, gameplay, or other interactions end Sworn Allegiance without triggering Everbright Protector.
Casting Everbright Protector causes all other Resonators in the team to leave the field.
Ruler's Realm lasts 30s.

When another team Resonator casts an Intro Skill within Ruler's Realm, that Resonator gains a shield equal to 650 plus 5% of Augusta's Max HP for 10s. This shield does not stack and is not transferred to the incoming Resonator.
Majesty: Augusta can hold up to 2 stacks.
Casting Undying Sunlight: Plunge grants 1 Majesty stack.
When another team Resonator casts an Outro Skill while affected by Augusta's Outro Skill - Battlesong of the Unyielding, Augusta gains 1 Majesty stack.
The Liberation attribute nodes provide ATK bonuses.

Maestro grants 120% ATK, makes Phrolova float, and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate shares Phrolova's stats and statuses, and its damage is treated as Phrolova's damage.
Hecate's attacks do not remove targets' Hazy Dream state.
During Maestro, Phrolova plays Volatile Notes in order; each note remains for 4s.
Damage taken by Hecate while Phrolova is active also affects Phrolova.

Active-field controls: Normal Attack commands Hecate to use Basic Attack - Hecate; after every 2 Hecate Basic Attacks, the next one becomes Enhanced Attack - Hecate. Dodge commands Hecate to dodge, and a successful dodge prevents damage from that hit. Jump resets Hecate's position. Resonance Liberation commands Curtain Call - Hecate and ends Maestro.

When Phrolova is not active, Hecate cannot take damage and automatically uses Basic Attack - Hecate. When a team Resonator casts an Echo Skill, Hecate uses Enhanced Attack - Hecate; this can trigger up to 10 times during one Maestro state, and an Echo of the same name can trigger it once.
Switching back to Phrolova ends Maestro. Ending Maestro removes all Volatile Notes.
Basic Attack - Hecate performs up to 2 attacks and deals Havoc DMG classified as Echo Skill DMG.
Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings is used when playing Volatile Note - Strings; it deals Havoc DMG, Stagnates targets, and is Echo Skill DMG.
Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds is used when playing Volatile Note - Winds; it deals Havoc DMG, pulls targets, and is Echo Skill DMG.
Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza is used when playing Volatile Note - Cadenza; it deals Havoc DMG, Stagnates and pulls targets, and is Echo Skill DMG.

Curtain Call - Hecate Stagnates targets and deals Havoc DMG. It can be cast when active Phrolova ends Maestro; when Phrolova is in Maestro and switches to Phrolova without using Intro; when Maestro ends while Phrolova is inactive and she switches in without using Intro; by pressing Resonance Liberation during Maestro; or by holding Resonance Liberation during Resolving Chord.
When Curtain Call is cast during Resolving Chord, it removes all Volatile Notes and ends Resolving Chord.

mechanics: Reduces Cartethyia's HP to 50% of maximum and transforms her into Fleurdelys for 12s, entering Manifest and unlocking her Forte moves. Can be cast in mid-air.

On hit, removes all target Aero Erosion stacks; each removed stack amplifies the target's damage taken by 20%, up to 5 stacks. Can be cast in mid-air.

mechanics: Standard Defense Protocol attacks the target, deals Spectro DMG, and enters a block stance. Switching Zani off the field ends the stance early.
Pressing Normal Attack within a certain time during Standard Defense Protocol performs Basic Attack Stage 3, recovers Redundant Energy, and Stagnates the target on hit.

When an enemy attacks Zani during the block stance, that instance of damage is reduced by 100%; nearby targets are Stagnated; Pinpoint Strike is cast, dealing Spectro DMG and reducing their Vibration Strength by an additional 5%. Zani's DMG taken is reduced by 30% for the next 2s.

Holding Resonance Skill during Crisis Response Protocol enters Ready Stance. Zani is immune to interruption in Ready Stance, which ends early if she is switched off the field.
Releasing the button or allowing Ready Stance to end consumes all Redundant Energy and casts Targeted Action, dealing Spectro DMG classified as Spectro Frazzle DMG.

If attacked during Crisis Response Protocol's Ready Stance, the attack instance deals no damage; all Redundant Energy is consumed to cast Forcible Riposte, dealing Spectro Frazzle DMG, Stagnating the target, and reducing its Vibration Strength by an additional 5%. Zani's DMG taken is reduced by 30% for the next 2s.
Casting Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte enters Sunburst mode and inflicts one Heliacal Ember stack on the target on hit. The attack's final stage recovers Blaze.

mechanics: Heliacal Ember: When Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts Spectro Frazzle on a target, all Spectro Frazzle stacks are immediately consumed and their corresponding DMG is triggered. Spectro Frazzle is then converted into the same number of Heliacal Ember stacks.
Each conversion grants Zani Blaze based on the number of converted Heliacal Ember stacks. Each converted stack grants 5 Blaze.
Heliacal Ember can have up to 60 stacks, and each stack lasts 6s. Heliacal Ember stacks count as Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata effect.
Casting Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte grants 10 Blaze.
Blaze is capped at 100 outside Inferno Mode and 150 during Inferno Mode.
Scorching Light becomes available in Inferno Mode. Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Dawning, Nightfall, and Lightsmash deal Spectro DMG classified as both Heavy Attack DMG and Spectro Frazzle DMG.
When Blaze is at least 30, Standard Defense Protocol is replaced by Scorching Light.
Holding Resonance Skill during Scorching Light enters Ready Stance. Zani is immune to interruption; switching her off the field ends the stance early.
Releasing Resonance Skill within the required timing during Ready Stance consumes Blaze and casts Heavy Slash - Daybreak.

If attacked during the relevant Ready Stance timing, the attack instance deals no damage; nearby targets are Stagnated; Heavy Slash - Lightsmash is cast, consuming Blaze and reducing targets' Vibration Strength by an additional 10%. Zani's DMG taken is reduced by 30% for the next 2s.

After Heavy Slash - Lightsmash, Basic Attack is replaced by Heavy Slash - Nightfall. It consumes up to 40 Blaze on hit, and each consumed Blaze increases Nightfall's DMG multiplier. If Nightfall Stage 1 is interrupted, pressing Basic Attack again casts Nightfall Stage 2.
Releasing the button after the required time or allowing Ready Stance to end immediately casts Heavy Slash - Nightfall.

When Blaze is at least 30, Basic Attack is replaced by Heavy Slash - Daybreak. After entering Inferno Mode, casting Basic Attack immediately replaces the current Basic Attack with Scorching Light; holding Basic Attack enters Ready Stance.
After Heavy Slash - Daybreak, pressing Basic Attack immediately casts Heavy Slash - Dawning at the cost of Blaze. After Dawning, Basic Attack is replaced by Nightfall.

If Basic Attack is not replaced by Nightfall after a successful Dodge and Zani has at least 30 Blaze, pressing Normal Attack within the relevant timing casts Heavy Slash - Lightsmash at the cost of Blaze.
Redundant Energy has a maximum of 100 points.
Zani gains Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target, when Intro Skill Immediate Execution is cast, when Standard Defense Protocol is cast, and when Pinpoint Strike is cast.
Zani cannot gain Redundant Energy during Inferno Mode.

Summons 5 Dim Star Butterflies that automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Following the skill with a Basic Attack at the appropriate time starts the Basic Attack cycle from Stage 2.
Can be performed in mid-air.

abilities.name: Astral Chord
mechanics: Flare Star Butterfly: Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a Collapsed Core. The Collapsed Core transforms into a Flare Star Butterfly after 6s.
Flare Star Butterflies automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG.
If 5 Collapsed Cores already exist, Shorekeeper's next Normal Attack hit instantly converts a Collapsed Core into a Flare Star Butterfly.

Illation: Requires 5 segments of Empirical Data. Casting Heavy Attack consumes all 5 segments, pulls in nearby targets, and deals Spectro DMG. All Collapsed Cores generated by this action instantly become Flare Star Butterflies.

Transmutation: Requires 5 segments of Empirical Data. Casting Mid-air Attack consumes all 5 segments and deals Spectro DMG. All Collapsed Cores generated by this action instantly become Flare Star Butterflies.
Quickly pressing the Normal Attack button after Transmutation performs Basic Attack Stage 2.
Empirical Data has a maximum capacity of 5 segments.
Basic Attack Stage 1, Stage 2, or Stage 4 hitting a target grants 1 Empirical Data segment.
Basic Attack Stage 3 hitting a target grants 2 Empirical Data segments.
A Mid-air Attack hitting a target grants 1 Empirical Data segment.
A Dodge Counter hitting a target grants 1 Empirical Data segment.

abilities.name: Life Entwined
mechanics: When a Resonator other than Shorekeeper would take a fatal blow, that Resonator is not knocked out.
Instead, the affected Resonator is healed for 50% of Shorekeeper's HP, while Shorekeeper loses the same amount of HP.
This effect cannot reduce Shorekeeper's HP below 1.
The effect can trigger once every 10 minutes.
quantitative_details: Fatal-blow protection healing: 50% of Shorekeeper's HP (skill Lv.1)

abilities.name: Self Gravitation
mechanics: When the on-field Resonator is within the effective range of a Stellarealm, Shorekeeper's Energy Regen increases.
Rover's Energy Regen also increases if Rover is on the team.

abilities.name: End Loop
mechanics: Generates an Outer Stellarealm.
Outer Stellarealm continuously restores HP for all party members within its effective range. This healing can trigger once every 3s.
When a party member uses an Intro Skill within the Outer Stellarealm, it evolves into the Inner Stellarealm.
Inner Stellarealm retains all Outer Stellarealm effects.
Within the Inner Stellarealm's effective range, all party members gain Crit. Rate based on Shorekeeper's Energy Regen: every 0.2% Energy Regen grants 0.01% Crit. Rate, up to 12.5%.
When a party member uses an Intro Skill within the Inner Stellarealm, it evolves into the Supernal Stellarealm.
Supernal Stellarealm retains all Inner Stellarealm effects.
Within the Supernal Stellarealm's effective range, all party members gain Crit. DMG based on Shorekeeper's Energy Regen: every 0.1% Energy Regen grants 0.01% Crit. DMG, up to 25%.
The Stellarealm duration and cooldown are provided in the source table below.
quantitative_details: Inner Stellarealm Crit. Rate conversion: 0.01% Crit. Rate per 0.2% Shorekeeper Energy Regen, up to 12.5% (skill Lv.1)
Supernal Stellarealm Crit. DMG conversion: 0.01% Crit. DMG per 0.1% Shorekeeper Energy Regen, up to 25% (skill Lv.1)

Casting Discernment ends the current Stellarealm, restores HP for all nearby party members, and deals Spectro DMG to targets.
Discernment is guaranteed to be a Critical Hit and deals Resonance Liberation DMG.
Discernment can trigger only once each time a Supernal Stellarealm is generated.

abilities.name: Ink and Wash
mechanics: Phantasmic Imprints are summoned by Manifestation or Heavy Attack: Conjuration by consuming Afflatus.
At most one each of Phantasmic Imprint - Left, - Middle, and - Right can exist simultaneously; each lasts 15s.

Heavy Attack - Conjuration consumes Stamina and deals Glacio DMG. It can be performed by briefly holding Basic Attack after Basic Attack 3, pressing Basic Attack shortly after Manifestation, holding Basic Attack shortly after Stroke of Genius or Creation's Zenith, holding Basic Attack while airborne, or holding Basic Attack after a successful Dodge.
If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any Heavy Attack - Conjuration method, 30 Afflatus is consumed to summon Phantasmic Imprint - Middle.
When a Phantasmic Imprint is nearby, Resonance Skill is replaced by Stroke of Genius, which can be cast in mid-air.
Stroke of Genius moves Zhezhi to the selected Phantasmic Imprint, removes it, and summons an Ivory Herald to attack the target. Its damage is Glacio DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG.
If the selected Imprint is in mid-air, Stroke of Genius refreshes the mid-air Dodge Counter.
Each Stroke of Genius grants one Painter's Delight stack. Painter's Delight lasts 8s and stacks up to 2 times.
When a Phantasmic Imprint is nearby and Painter's Delight has 2 stacks, Stroke of Genius is replaced by Creation's Zenith, which can be cast in mid-air.
Creation's Zenith removes all Painter's Delight stacks, moves Zhezhi to and removes the selected Phantasmic Imprint, and summons an Ivory Herald to attack the target.
Creation's Zenith deals greater Glacio DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG and increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 18% for 27s.
If the selected Imprint is in mid-air, Creation's Zenith refreshes the mid-air Dodge Counter.
Afflatus has a maximum of 90 points and is gained from Normal Attacks and the Intro Skill.

mechanics: Jinhsi can hold up to 50 Incandescence.

While in Incarnation, Incarnation - Basic Attack replaces Basic Attack. It performs up to 4 consecutive strikes, deals Spectro DMG treated as Resonance Skill DMG, does not reset its Basic Attack cycle, and can be cast in mid-air.
While in Incarnation, Crescent Divinity replaces Resonance Skill, deals Spectro DMG, and can be cast in mid-air.
While in Incarnation, Incarnation - Heavy Attack becomes available. It attacks the target in mid-air, consumes Stamina, and deals Spectro DMG.
While in Incarnation, Incarnation - Dodge Counter becomes available, deals Spectro DMG, and can be cast in mid-air.
After Incarnation - Basic Attack Stage 4, Incarnation ends and Jinhsi gains Ordination Glow. Ordination Glow lasts 5s.
While Ordination Glow lasts, Basic Attack is replaced by Incarnation - Heavy Attack, which attacks the target in mid-air, consumes Stamina, and deals Spectro DMG.
While Ordination Glow lasts, Resonance Skill is replaced by Illuminous Epiphany. It sends out a Solar Flare that detonates Stella Glamor after a short delay and deals Spectro DMG.
Illuminous Epiphany consumes up to 50 Incandescence. Each consumed Incandescence point grants a bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to Stella Glamor.
Illuminous Epiphany can be cast in mid-air.
After casting Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi gains Unison. This can trigger once every 25s.
Unison lasts 5s. While Jinhsi has Unison, switching to another Resonator removes Unison and triggers Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill.
When Concerto Energy is full, Unison is consumed before Concerto Energy when switching out.
When Jinhsi is in the party, nearby party Resonators gain Eras in Unity.

Cosmos Rave replaces Heavy Attack with Cosmos: Heavy Attack, which consumes Stamina, deals Fusion DMG, and is classified as Heavy Attack damage.
Cosmos Rave replaces Flaming Woolies with Resonance Skill Cosmos: Rampage, which deals Fusion DMG classified as Resonance Skill damage.
During Cosmos Rave, after a successful Dodge, use Basic Attack to perform Cosmos: Dodge Counter, dealing Fusion DMG classified as Basic Attack damage.

During Cosmos Rave, Heavy Attack—Cosmos Rupture can be activated if Dissonance is full; it consumes all Dissonance and enters Cosmos' Dissonance state, reducing damage taken by 70%. Switching characters does not interrupt the state.
During Cosmos Rave, attacks that hit targets restore Dissonance.
Cosmos Rave lasts 10s.
